title: 第26章 我们不需要平手第27章 气系符文
content_zh:
一指点出，热浪滔天，火属性的真元躁动激荡，将四周空气灼热。
真元经过炎龙脉炼化，有了质的提升，对陆沉的力量也起到一定增幅。
只是，增幅不多。
指力五万斤，是陆沉现时最大极限！
但若是点中要害，也能重创周若雪。
“放肆！”
周若雪脸色大变，但她修为高，反应快，即使非常仓促，也能及时抬手格挡。
啪！
一指点在手臂上，传出一道爆响。
周若雪的身形晃了晃，手臂没什么损伤，但被点中之处，有些剧痛。
而陆沉则被震退几步，指尖一阵麻木，周若雪始终比他高四个小境界，光是真元反震，他就有点吃不消了。
现场传出一阵叹息，人们纷纷摇头。
实力太悬殊，就算先发制人也没有用。
陆沉再怎么努力，也注定徒劳无功，最后只能被周若雪吊打。
这场决赛，胜负没有任何悬念了。
看台上，三位长老的注意力，已经不在擂台上了。
唯独周鹤眉飞色舞，兴致勃勃的盯着擂台，等待周若雪虐杀陆沉的一幕。
陆家的长老们脸色都不好看，大长老甚至寻思替陆沉认输，是否有用
自然，最紧张的就是婉儿了。
陆沉是她的主人，是她生命中最重要的男人，陆沉有任何闪失，她都无法接受。

此刻，周若雪已经暴怒，抬手蓄力，准备一举灭杀陆沉。
原本，她想虐杀陆沉，让陆沉毫无体面的去死。
但现在看来，还是迅速解决的好，以免夜长梦多。
咔！
陆沉的身体传出一道微弱的爆响。
当即，陆沉气息大增，气势恢宏，整个人的精神焕然一新。
突破了！
真元境二重！
现场所有的目光，顿时聚焦在陆沉上身。
人们惊讶不已，陆沉居然在擂台上突破境界，实属不易。
可是，仍然没人看好陆沉。
人家周若雪是真元境五重巅峰，你陆沉才真元境二重，有可能翻身吗
“哈哈…”
陆沉仰天大笑，心中积压的闷气一扫而空。
终于突破了！
现时，二万斤基础力量！
炎龙武脉增幅一倍！
若使用炎阳指，这门地阶上品战技在此基础上，再增幅一倍。
content_en:
As soon as he pointed out, a heat wave surged into the sky, and the fire-attributed essence stirred up, scorching the air around him.
The true essence has been refined through the Yanlong Vein and has been qualitatively improved, which has also increased Lu Chen's strength to a certain extent.
However, the increase is not much.
Fifty thousand kilograms of finger strength is Lu Chen's current maximum limit!
But if it hits the key point, it can also severely damage Zhou Ruoxue.
"Presumptuous!"
Zhou Ruoxue's face changed drastically, but she was highly cultivated and had quick reactions. Even if she was in a hurry, she could still raise her hand to block in time.
Snap!
A finger pointed on the arm, and there was an explosion.
Zhou Ruoxue's figure was shaken. There was no damage to her arm, but there was some sharp pain where she was hit.
Lu Chen was knocked back a few steps, and his fingertips became numb. Zhou Ruoxue was always four levels higher than him, so just the shock of the real energy was a bit too much for him.
There was a sigh and people shook their heads.
There is such a disparity in strength that even a preemptive strike would be useless.
No matter how hard Lu Chen tried, it was destined to be in vain, and in the end he could only be beaten by Zhou Ruoxue.
In this final, there is no suspense about the outcome.
In the stands, the attention of the three elders was no longer on the stage.
Only Zhou He's eyebrows were dancing with excitement, staring at the ring with interest, waiting for the scene where Zhou Ruoxue brutally killed Lu Chen.
The elders of the Lu family all looked ugly. The eldest elder even considered whether it would be useful to admit defeat for Lu Chen.
Naturally, Wan'er was the most nervous.
Lu Chen is her master and the most important man in her life. She cannot accept any mistakes made by Lu Chen.
At this moment, Zhou Ruoxue was furious and raised her hand to gather strength, preparing to kill Lu Chen in one fell swoop.
Originally, she wanted to torture Lu Chen and let him die without dignity.
But now it seems that it is better to solve it quickly to avoid long nights and dreams.
Click!
A faint explosion came from Lu Chen's body.
Immediately, Lu Chen's aura increased greatly, his momentum was magnificent, and his whole spirit was renewed.
Breakthrough!
Second level of True Essence Realm!
All eyes at the scene immediately focused on Lu Chen's upper body.
People were surprised. It was not easy for Lu Chen to break through in the ring.
However, no one is still optimistic about Lu Chen.
Zhou Ruoxue is at the peak of the fifth level of the True Yuan Realm. You, Lu Chen, are at the second level of the True Yuan Realm. Is it possible to turn around?
"Haha..."
Lu Chen looked up to the sky and laughed, and the sullenness in his heart was swept away.
Finally a breakthrough!
Now, the basic strength is 20,000 kilograms!
Yanlong's martial arteries doubled in size!
If you use the Flame Finger, this high-grade combat skill on the ground level will be doubled in power.
